fiat-panda.note: No 4x4 in the current Pandina range (1.0 Hybrid only); the old Panda 4x4 is discontinued

lancia-ypsilon.note: Ypsilon HF (280 PS BEV) is FWD; 'HF Integrale' AWD is only the Rally2 competition car

opel-mokka.note: Mokka GSE (280 PS) is FWD too

fiat-600.note: No 4x4 version found (unlike sister models Jeep Avenger 4xe and Alfa Romeo Junior Q4)

abarth-600e.note: Scorpionissima (280 PS) is FWD with a mechanical limited-slip differential

jeep-avenger.note: AWD only on the Avenger 4xe (1.2 e-Hybrid 145 PS with rear e-motor); petrol, e-Hybrid and Electric FWD

peugeot-3008.note: AWD only on the E-3008 Dual Motor 325 (BEV); Hybrid, Plug-in Hybrid and single-motor E-3008 FWD

citroen-c5-aircross.note: No AWD version (Hybrid, Plug-in Hybrid and ë-C5 Aircross all FWD)

ds-ds-7.note: AWD on the Plug-in Hybrid 4x4 300 and 4x4 360; Plug-in Hybrid 225 and diesel (Ligne Noire edition) FWD

leapmotor-b10.note: BEV and Hybrid EV (range extender) both rear-driven

peugeot-5008.note: AWD only on the E-5008 Dual Motor 325 (BEV); Hybrid, Plug-in Hybrid and single-motor E-5008 FWD
